title: The Isoperimetric Conjecture for the Cubic Flat Three-Torus
summary: We prove the isoperimetric conjecture for the cubic flat three-torus and classify all minimizers, including the equality cases at the transition volumes $`4\pi/81`$ and $`1/\pi`$. The minimizing regions are balls, circular tubes about shortest closed geodesics, coordinate slabs, and their complements.
